result.summary: The application interface appears mostly functional, but there is a major UI redundancy/error in the restaurant list.

issues.description: Duplicate restaurant listings appearing in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Review the backend query or frontend logic to prevent duplicate restaurant card entries from appearing in the same horizontal scrollable list.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Bu...' restaurant title is significantly truncated even for a short list view, making it hard to identify the full brand name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text styling or container width for restaurant titles in horizontal carousels to allow slightly more character display before truncation.
